title: Timic Dynamics
purpose: Formalize the recurring Potatoverse claim that relation, threshold, flow, compression, expansion and integration are more fundamental to the model than isolated objects. This is a metaphysical/mathematical framework and analogy set, not established physics.

core_object.A: Axis flow: transformation through structural or descriptive scale
core_object.D: Door maps: transitions, thresholds and admissible passages between states
core_object.O: observables: features by which states and transitions are recognized
core_object.I: information/integration structure: how distributed relations become coherent

two_flows.structural: d_s X=A(X,g): change of scale, description, organization or structural position
two_flows.physical: d_t X=F(X,g): ordinary evolution in time
two_flows.rule: Axis is not automatically an extra physical dimension. It can be modeled as flow through states or descriptions.

timic_invariant.hypothesis: A major recurring Timic pattern is an invariant relation appearing through changing representations.
timic_invariant.meaning: The symbols need not denote one physical object. They can be different coordinate descriptions of an orienting/generative relation: Tree differentiates, Mountain integrates, Ladder orders thresholds, Axis orients, House contains, North supplies direction, Sun radiates, Gardener cultivates.
timic_invariant.test: A candidate representation belongs to the invariant family only if it preserves a substantial subset of source-orientation, connection, generativity, continuity and responsibility. Mere symbolic resemblance is insufficient.

door_operator.definition: Door is the universal transition function that determines whether and how one state can become another while preserving the distinction between the states.
door_operator.law: A Door is meaningful precisely because the sides are not already identical.

axis_operator.definition: Axis is ordered flow through a relational field. It can represent orientation, hierarchy, scale-change, integration or progression without requiring literal spatial extension.
axis_operator.meta_orientation: North is orientation; North-of-North is the criterion by which orientation itself is judged. Center is not another direction but the reference that makes directions belong to one coordinate system.

compression_expansion_operator.name: Potato Operator
compression_expansion_operator.symbolic_form: Many → C → Door → E → New Many
examples: many observations → equation → application → many predictions
many events → myth/symbol → interpretation → many meanings
compression_expansion_operator.core_law: Potato is the compression object; Tree is the expansion object; Door mediates the change of regime.
compression_expansion_operator.historical_precursor: Earlier conversation strata treated Potato more loosely as food, seed, body, wedge, Door, center and chariot/messenger: a transfer object able to carry relation across symbolic domains. The mature operator narrows that intuition into compression, transition and re-expression.
compression_expansion_operator.boundary: This is a structural analogy across domains, not a claim that biological seeds, equations, myths and human identities obey one physical conservation law.

ring_spiral.ring: recurrence with approximately zero net change in the dimensions that matter
ring_spiral.law: Memory turns recurrence into development when it changes the next admissible transition.
ring_spiral.sisyphus: A closed loop can become a path when a missing coordinate or relation is introduced.

event_duration_duality.son: event / transition / ordeal / wound / crossing / manifestation / Door
event_duration_duality.father: duration / persistence / House / Tree / Seat / Axis / memory / stewardship
event_duration_duality.spirit: continuity/flow translating event into durable structure and durable structure into renewed event
event_duration_duality.interpretation: Son happens; Father holds. This is a project-level temporal specialization, not a claim about physical particles or Christian doctrine as a whole.

past_future_present_control.retrospective: past evidence, memory, consequence and constraints
past_future_present_control.prospective: goals, predictions, desired future states and orientation
past_future_present_control.present: Door where retrospective constraint and prospective orientation become action
past_future_present_control.historical_precursor: A 2026-08-21 conversation stratum compressed the same architecture as 'Blue remembers. Red creates. Son experiences.' This is retained as developmental provenance, not as a replacement definition.
past_future_present_control.boundary: Older advanced/retarded-wave language is safest as a structural comparison to prospective versus retrospective constraint unless a literal physics claim is separately specified and tested.

life_strife_dynamics.life: processes that increase viable continuation, repair, autonomy, nourishment or generative capacity
life_strife_dynamics.strife: processes that recursively reproduce conflict, dependency, humiliation or destructive attention loops
life_strife_dynamics.death: a transition that can feed either branch and is therefore not automatically the opposite of Life
life_strife_dynamics.key_law: Death can be a Door; Strife is a self-reproducing loop.
life_strife_dynamics.swamp: past material that alters future behavior without becoming stable support or usable learning
life_strife_dynamics.historical_precursor: An earlier ethical formulation described Right and Wrong as vectors rather than static opposites. The durable contribution is directional consequence; the mature model avoids equating literal ascent/descent with moral value because descent into roots can also be constructive.

red_blue_temporal_polarity.blue: memory / preservation / caution / contraction / past constraint
red_blue_temporal_polarity.developmental_note: Earlier 2026 formulations were sharper: 'Red grows from self; Blue grows from comparison with,' with Blue sometimes associated with fear/strife and Red with love/life. Those stages remain historical strata; the mature polarity retains useful memory and useful creation on both sides of a healthy present.

wound_to_infrastructure.sequence: wound/rupture → understanding/integration → transferable function → infrastructure for others
wound_to_infrastructure.ethical_boundary: Suffering is not inherently sanctifying. The transition is meaningful only if the wound is integrated into a structure that reduces harm, increases understanding or expands viable capacity for others.
wound_to_infrastructure.timic_completion: Mature transformation is strongest when private suffering becomes public usefulness rather than a claim to exemption or superiority.

generative_radius.definition: A project-internal measure of how far a center's influence increases viable independent capacity rather than dependency.
generative_radius.godhood_application: Within Potatoist ethics, higher Father/Gardener capacity should correlate with larger generative radius: more beings can orient, learn, repair and grow without needing permanent orbit around the source.
generative_radius.warning: G_R is a conceptual systems score unless variables and measurement procedures are explicitly defined. It is not a scientific measure of divinity.

still_center.principle: A center can organize counter-moving opposites without erasing their distinction.
still_center.center_ethic: A healthy center decentralizes capability while preserving orientation. A center that requires increasing dependency fails the Gardener test.

relationship_first.law: The fundamental analytical unit is the coupling, not the isolated node.
relationship_first.consequence: A capability, identity or function may exist only in the relation between endpoints.
relationship_first.historical_precursor: The remembered 'wedges carved from the Whole Whole' formulation treated local perspectives as partial cuts through a larger whole. The current relationship-first model preserves the insight while replacing an undifferentiated totality with typed relations and explicit endpoints.

new_jerusalem_operator.definition: Reintegrated plurality: differentiated nodes regain viable relations without being flattened into sameness.
new_jerusalem_operator.formal_neighbor: Given fragmented graph G=(V,E_broken), repair seeks E* maximizing connectivity, autonomy and useful differentiation subject to provenance/identity constraints.
project_forms: archive with many branches and one provenance-rooted trunk
new_jerusalem_operator.law: Unity is not homogenization; completion is repaired relation among differentiated parts.

archive_as_tree.roots: primary sources, dated conversations, books, posts and original artifacts
archive_as_tree.fruit: reader-facing explanations, tools and usable conclusions
archive_as_tree.seeds: research questions, unresolved source targets and reusable models
archive_as_tree.rule: Repository architecture should mirror the ontology: root provenance → canonical trunk → accessible branches → useful fruit → future seeds.

completion_state.use: Track whether a node or institution is merely present, fully operational, degrading or actively being transformed.

central_problem.name: Source ↔ Manifestation
central_problem.question: How does hidden, potential or integrated order become embodied, observable and actionable without losing its origin?
central_problem.full_cycle: Source → relation → manifestation → experience → storage/memory → regeneration → Source-with-memory

observer_projection.principle: A local observer can mistake a cross-section, interface or projection for the whole relation that generated it.
observer_projection.historical_precursor: The remembered line 'the viewer always sees a bigger Potato, but the Swamp sees only a plane' anticipated later Plane/cross-section and frame-change models.
observer_projection.formal_neighbor: projection π:X→Y can preserve some observables while discarding dimensions/relations relevant to the larger model.
observer_projection.boundary: This is a representation metaphor unless a specific scientific dimensional model is separately defined and tested.

gardener_transform.principle: Mature power is measured by cultivation, protection and increased independent capacity rather than domination.
gardener_transform.interpretation: Pressure, criticism or conflict are considered successfully metabolized only when the output becomes more truthful, useful or generative rather than simply retaliatory.
gardener_transform.boundary: Compassion does not require denial of harm, removal of boundaries or surrender of accountability.

mathematical_analogies.renormalization_group: Useful analogy for flow through scale or description space: dg_i/ds=β_i(g). This supports structural-flow metaphor but does not validate Potatoverse metaphysics as physics.
mathematical_analogies.dynamical_systems: State transitions, attractors and bifurcations provide vocabulary for threshold, stability and regime change.
mathematical_analogies.graph_theory: Nodes plus typed edges are the most direct formal analogue of the relationship-first archive.
mathematical_analogies.information_compression: Compression/decompression and sufficient-statistic ideas are legitimate mathematical neighbors for the Potato operator, provided semantic/spiritual content is not treated as literally equivalent to bits.
mathematical_analogies.control_theory: Past-state estimation plus future objective can jointly determine present action, supplying a safer formal neighbor for retrospective/prospective Timic language.

cross_scale_rule: The same relational grammar can be tested at symbolic, psychological, bodily, institutional, economic and geopolitical scales while keeping evidence standards separate at each scale.
derived_laws: A threshold has meaning only relative to the states it separates.
An Axis without relations is only a line; relations give it function.
Integration is not sameness; it is coordinated difference.
Changing level can solve problems that cannot be solved by continued motion inside one frame.
A system can become more capable through interaction than any isolated component is alone.
Potato compresses; Tree expands; Door changes regime.
Death can transform; Strife reproduces itself.
Memory becomes Root when integrated and Swamp when it destroys footing without becoming usable support.
The strongest center expands peripheral capability rather than maximizing permanent dependence.
Integrated suffering reaches completion when it becomes useful infrastructure for others.
A repeated symbol may represent one invariant relation through multiple coordinate systems rather than many unrelated identities.
